# Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Trust

> Patient and professional resources for NHS hospital services in Gloucestershire, including virtual consultations, urgent care guidance, and comprehensive patient information leaflets.

Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Trust operates multiple hospital sites including Cheltenham General Hospital and provides a wide range of acute medical, surgical, and specialist services. The site serves patients, healthcare professionals, and visitors with clinical information, appointment services, and pre-operative guidance.

## Key Topics

- NHS video calling
- Virtual consultations
- Urgent care services
- Patient information leaflets
- Cheltenham General Hospital
- Surgical procedures
- Critical care
- Outpatient services
- Pre-operative guidance
- Telemedicine
- NHS 111
- Emergency care
- Hospital wards
- Healthcare professionals
- Appointment booking

## Patient Care and Services

- [Urgent advice and care](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/urgent-advice-and-care): Guide to urgent care services, NHS 111, and emergency healthcare options
- [NHS video calling](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/our-services/services-we-offer/nhs-video-calling): NHS video calling service for remote consultations and virtual clinics
- [For Healthcare Professionals](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/healthcare-professionals): Professional resources including Joint Formulary and hospital services

## Hospital Wards and Facilities

- [Department of Critical Care (Cheltenham)](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/our-wards/department-critical-care-cheltenham): Critical care and ICU ward information at Cheltenham General Hospital
- [Surgical Assessment and Admissions Suite (SAAS)](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/our-wards/surgical-admissions-suite): Pre-operative information and admission procedures for surgical patients
- [Snowshill and Bibury Ward](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/our-wards/snowshill-bibury-ward): Ward information for orthopaedic patients at Cheltenham General Hospital

## Surgical and Procedure Guidance

- [Having a ureteric stent](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/having-a-ureteric-stent): Patient information on ureteric stent placement and post-procedure care
- [Intermittent Self-Catheterisation (ISC) for adults](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/intermittent-self-catheterisation-isc-adults): Adult patient education guide for intermittent self-catheterisation technique
- [Sacrocolpopexy](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/sacrocolpopexy-ghpi1283_09_21): Pre-operative guide for sacrocolpopexy pelvic organ prolapse surgery
- [Outpatient 'See and treat' hysteroscopy and endometrial polypectomy](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/outpatient-see-and-treat-hysteroscopy-and-endometrial-polypectomy-ghpi1579): Pre-procedure guide for outpatient hysteroscopy and polyp removal
- [Self-administration of a phosphate enema](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/self-administration-of-a-phosphate-enema-ghpi1236): Pre-procedure guidance for bowel preparation with phosphate enema

## Medical Conditions and Treatment

- [Colon cancer](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/colon-cancer): Patient information on colon cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment options
- [Clostridioides difficile Infection](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/clostridioides-difficile-infection): Patient leaflet on C. difficile infection, control measures, and treatment
- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/acceptance-and-commitment-therapy-ghpi1606): Patient guide to ACT for chronic pain management and mental health
- [The Gloucestershire Brain Injury Team](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/the-gloucestershire-brain-injury-team): Information on brain injury rehabilitation services and team contacts

## Eye Care and Ophthalmology

- [Eye drops](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/eye-drops-ghpi0067): Instructions for applying eye drops and medication administration guidance
- [Eye laser treatment - Yag iridotomy](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/eye-laser-treatment-yag-iridotomy): Patient guide to YAG iridotomy laser treatment for angle-closure glaucoma
- [Meibomian Cysts (Chalazion)](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/your-visit/patient-information-leaflets/meibomian-cysts-chalazion-ghpi0189): Patient information on chalazion eyelid cysts and treatment options

## Optional Resources

- [Our Charity](https://www.gloshospitals.nhs.uk/charity): Cheltenham and Gloucester Hospitals Charity fundraising and donations
